QuestInfo.name: Broken Patrol Robot
QuestInfo.0: There are robots outside of Edelstein. Professor Allen is said to have made them, for what purpose he made robots to attack people is unknown. Go see Professor Allen.
QuestInfo.1: Allen had originally developed the robots to attack intruders but it seems like something has gone haywire with the robots and now they believe everyone is an intruder. Memory card is needed to fix the robot.
QuestInfo.2: You retrieved memory card for Allen so that he can fix the robots.

0.0: Y-yes, I made the robots outside Edelstein to help keep everyone safe. They're supposed to only attack intruders, but something's gone wrong. Now they're attacking everyone! C-can you help me fix them?

yes.0: I just need to study the robots' core parts. Bring me #r10 #t4009027##k, #r10 #t4009031##k, and #r10 #t4009032##k items.

no.0: Oh no. Whatever shall I do then?

1.0: With these, I can fix them up in a jiffy.

default.0: I need to study the robots' #rmemory cards#k and #rcircuit chips#k to figure out what's wrong.
